title: WS-3 derived-reconstruction corpus metadata
description: Top-level metadata file (dataset_metadata.json) deposited at the root of the WS-3 derived-reconstruction corpus alongside MANIFEST.sha256. Describes a Scientific Data Data Descriptor's released artifact: reference reconstructions + per-pixel uncertainty maps + paired error maps + task-score maps + signal-equivalence credentials over the WS-1 PWM-LDCT benchmark. Validate the corpus's dataset_metadata.json against this schema before deposit.

schema_version.description: Pinned metadata-schema identifier. Bump only on a breaking metadata change.

title.description: Human-readable corpus title; should match the manuscript and repository landing page.

description.description: One-paragraph summary of what the corpus contains and what it is for.

doi.description: Repository DOI (figshare/Zenodo). null until minted; required to be non-null at submission. IPFS CID is NOT a substitute.

release_date.description: ISO-8601 release date; null until deposit is finalized.

data_license.description: Licence for the data records. Scientific Data preference.

code_license.description: Licence for the generating pipeline / RunBundle.

creators.description: Authors/creators. At least one must be the corresponding author with an ORCID.

orcid.description: ORCID iD; required for the corresponding author.

source_dataset.description: The raw benchmark this corpus is derived from (WS-1). Establishes distinctness for Scientific Data review.

relation.description: This corpus is the reconstruction/uncertainty/credential layer derived from the source raw scans.

generating_pipeline.description: How the records were produced; must permit bit-identical regeneration.

commit.description: Git commit the pipeline was run at.

runbundle_cid.description: IPFS CID of the pinned RunBundle (supplementary integrity anchor).

l4_cert_id.description: PWM L4 cert identifier anchoring the RunBundle.

library_versions.description: Exact pins of load-bearing libraries used for generation.

dose_ratios.description: Signal ratios r present in the corpus, e.g. [0.10, 0.25, 0.50, 1.00].

vendors.description: CT vendors represented, e.g. [Siemens, GE, Canon].

released_split.description: Only the held-out test split is released as records (train/val are not, to avoid leakage).

patient_level.description: Splits are patient-level (no patient crosses train/test).

record_types.description: One entry per released record type; counts/sizes must match MANIFEST.sha256 and the manuscript tab:records_counts.

path_glob.description: Glob locating these records within the corpus root.

dtype.description: e.g. float32 for NIfTI image records.

credential.description: Pins the WS-2 framework version every credential.json was issued under.

audited_with.description: Tool + version used to audit every credential, e.g. pwm-audit 0.2.2.

related_identifiers.description: External identifiers this corpus relates to (manuscript DOI, WS-1 DOI, RunBundle CID, L4 cert).
